result.topic_en: Scattered calculations on theta characteristics (binary arrays), a determinant-like relation among products of letters, a quadratic identity relating a square to a product of four linear factors, a 4x4 index array, and faint pencil notes on quotients of theta constants expressed as fourth roots of products of differences of branch points, with a Greek quotation from Epictetus.
